name: hyperwave-app-core
description: HyperWave app core: the framework-agnostic view-model both hosts (the Electron renderer and the React Native app) drive — the wave directory, the active wave, the ended-wave lifecycle, wallet meta, and the tip choreography. No DOM, no React, no engine import.
author: Mokhtar Naamani <mokhtar.naamani@gmail.com>

scripts.lint:jsdoc: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --strict --skipLibCheck --maxNodeModuleJsDepth 0 --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler lib/app-core.js lib/theme.js lib/wallet-meta.js lib/topic.js 2>&1 | grep -E 'error TS80' ; test $? -eq 1
